title: Ansel and the Border
author: Kestrel Amberdale
blurb: Oscar Oyelaran, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
